protocol.scope: Authored, privileged-state rigid-block task in native reference physics. No learned policy, shoe physics, human-video action recovery or physical robot qualification.
protocol.split_note: Seeded synthetic layouts, not independent physical captures. Confirmation is a user declaration; this tool cannot establish whether a seed/layout was previously inspected.
protocol.comparison: Open-jaw control replays the placement issued arm targets with jaws requested open; hold preserves initial arm targets. All attempts use the same scene timeout.
protocol.timing_boundary: Attempt wall time includes asset checks, compilation, reset, planning, stepping and trace capture; separate inner timings identify narrower boundaries. No rendering, sensing, training, disk serialization, transport or physical actuation.

hardware.memory_scope: Process lifetime high-water resident memory including imports, native models and traces, before final bundle inspection or replay export; not per-episode memory or minimum RAM. Null means unavailable.
